lance_williams =: 4 : 0
    'a b k' =. y
    merged =. a+b
    select. x
    case. 'single' do. 0.5 0.5 0 _0.5
    case. 'complete' do. 0.5 0.5 0 0.5
    case. 'average' do. (a%merged),(b%merged),0 0
    case. 'weighted' do. 0.5 0.5 0 0
    case. 'centroid' do.
        ((a%merged),(b%merged),(-a*b)%(merged*merged)),0
    case. 'median' do. 0.5 0.5 _0.25 0
    case. do.
        total =. a+b+k
        ((a+k)%total),((b+k)%total),(-k%total),0
    end.
)
agglomerate =: 4 : 0
    count =. #y
    capacity =. (2*count)-1
    squared =. (<x)e.'centroid';'median';'ward'
    values =. (capacity,capacity)$0.0
    for_i. i.count do.
        for_j. i.count do.
            value =. (<i,j){y
            if. squared do. value =. value*value end.
            values =. value (<i,j)}values
        end.
    end.
    sizes =. capacity$1
    active =. i.count
    merges =. 0$a:
    for_step. i.count-1 do.
        a =. 0{active
        b =. 1{active
        best =. (<a,b){values
        for_position. i.#active do.
            first =. position{active
            for_second. (position+1)}.active do.
                value =. (<first,second){values
                if. value<best do. a =. first
                    b =. second
                    best =. value end.
            end.
        end.
        node =. count+step
        size =. (a{sizes)+b{sizes
        sizes =. size node}sizes
        height =. best
        if. squared do. height =. %:height end.
        merges =. merges,<(<a),(<b),(<height),<size
        for_k. active do.
            if. k e.a,b do. continue. end.
            'alpha_a alpha_b beta gamma' =. x lance_williams (a{sizes),(b{sizes),k{sizes
            first =. (<a,k){values
            second =. (<b,k){values
            value =. alpha_a*first
            value =. value+alpha_b*second
            value =. value+beta*best
            value =. value+gamma*|first-second
            values =. value (<node,k)}values
            values =. value (<k,node)}values
        end.
        active =. (active#~-.active e.a,b),node
    end.
    merges
)
minimum_spanning_tree =: 3 : 0
    count =. #y
    in_tree =. 1,(count-1)$0
    keys =. 0{y
    parents =. count$0
    edges =. 0$a:
    for_step. i.count-1 do.
        chosen =. _1
        for_u. I.-.in_tree do.
            if. chosen<0 do. chosen =. u
            elseif. (u{keys)<chosen{keys do. chosen =. u end.
        end.
        in_tree =. 1 chosen}in_tree
        edges =. edges,<(<chosen{parents),(<chosen),<chosen{keys
        for_u. I.-.in_tree do.
            value =. (<chosen,u){y
            if. value<u{keys do. keys =. value u}keys
                parents =. chosen u}parents end.
        end.
    end.
    edges
)

read_lines =: 3 : '<;._2 (1!:1 <''input/'',y)'
decimal =: 3 : 0
    normalized =. '_' (I.y='-')}y
    0".normalized
)
setting =: 3 : '(SettingNames i.<y){::SettingValues'

    lines =. read_lines 'data.csv'
    FeatureNames =: 2}.','split 0{::lines
    FeatureCount =: #FeatureNames
    Ids =: Labels =: 0$a:
    Raw =: (0,FeatureCount)$0.0

        fields =. ','split >line

    DistanceName =: 0{::setting 'DISTANCE'

write_lines =: 4 : 0
    text =. ''

    text 1!:2 <'output/',x
)

ordered_children =: 4 : 0
    minimum =. i.y
    children =. 0 2$0
    for_merge. x do.
        merge =. >merge
        a =. 0{::merge
        b =. 1{::merge
        if. (a{minimum)<b{minimum do. children =. children,a,b
        else. children =. children,b,a end.
        minimum =. minimum,(a{minimum)<.b{minimum
    end.
    children
)
leaf_order =: 4 : 0
    order =. 0$0
    pending =. ,x+(#y)-1
    while. #pending do.
        node =. {:pending
        pending =. }:pending
        if. node<x do. order =. order,node
        else. pending =. pending,|.(node-x){y end.
    end.
    order
)
height_column =: 4 : 0
    'maximum width' =. x
    position =. <.(y%maximum)*width
    if. position>width do. width+1 else. position end.
)
dendrogram_rows =: 3 : 0
    'tree maximum cut_columns' =. y
    'count merges heights children order members depths subtree_heights' =. tree
    grid =. (count,Width+1)$0
    anchor =. ((2*count)-1)$0
    anchor =. (i.count)order}anchor
    for_column. cut_columns do.
        if. column>Width do. continue. end.
        for_row. i.count do. grid =. 1 (<row,column)}grid end.
    end.
    columns =. 0$0
    for_height. heights do. columns =. columns,(maximum,Width)height_column height end.
    for_step. i.#merges do.
        'upper lower' =. step{children
        column =. step{columns
        for_child. upper,lower do. grid =. 4 (<(child{anchor),column)}grid end.
        start_row =. 1+upper{anchor
        end_row =. lower{anchor
        for_row. start_row+i.end_row-start_row do.
            cell =. <row,column
            grid =. (3>.cell{grid)cell}grid
        end.
        for_child. upper,lower do.
            start =. 0
            if. child>:count do. start =. 1+(child-count){columns end.
            for_position. start+i.0>.column-start do.
                cell =. <(child{anchor),position
                grid =. (2>.cell{grid)cell}grid
            end.
        end.
        anchor =. (((upper{anchor)+lower{anchor)div 2)(count+step)}anchor
    end.
    id_width =. >./#&>Ids
    label_width =. >./#&>Labels
    rows =. 0$a:
    for_row. i.count do.
        leaf =. row{order
        id =. leaf{::Ids
        label =. leaf{::Labels
        text =. id,((id_width-#id)$' '),' ',label,((label_width-#label)$' '),' ',(row{grid){' :-|+'
        while. ' '={:text do. text =. }:text end.
        rows =. rows,<text
    end.
    scale =. ''
    for_column. i.Width+1 do.
        if. 0=10|column do. scale =. scale,'+'
        else. scale =. scale,'-' end.
    end.
    rows,<((id_width+label_width+2)$' '),scale
)

sequential_sum =: 3 : 0
    total =. 0.0
    for_value. y do. total =. total+value end.
    total
)
squared_distance =: 4 : 0
    total =. 0.0
    for_index. i.#x do.
        difference =. (index{x)-index{y
        total =. total+difference*difference
    end.
    total
)
feature_statistics =: 3 : 0
    means =. deviations =. 0$0.0
    for_feature. i.{:$y do.
        values =. feature{"1 y
        mean =. (sequential_sum values)%#y
        squares =. 0.0
        for_value. values do.
            difference =. value-mean
            squares =. squares+difference*difference
        end.
        means =. means,mean
        deviations =. deviations,%:squares%(#y)-1
    end.
    (<means),<deviations
)
standardize_vectors =: 4 : 0
    'means deviations' =. x
    rows =. (0,#means)$0.0
    for_row. y do. rows =. rows,(row-means)%deviations end.
    rows
)
vector_distance =: 4 : 0
    'first second' =. y
    if. x-:'euclidean' do. %:first squared_distance second
    elseif. x-:'manhattan' do. sequential_sum |first-second
    else.
        mean_first =. (sequential_sum first)%#first
        mean_second =. (sequential_sum second)%#second
        cross =. first_squares =. second_squares =. 0.0
        for_index. i.#first do.
            a =. (index{first)-mean_first
            b =. (index{second)-mean_second
            cross =. cross+a*b
            first_squares =. first_squares+a*a
            second_squares =. second_squares+b*b
        end.
        1-cross%%:first_squares*second_squares
    end.
)
distance_matrix =: 4 : 0
    count =. #y
    matrix =. (count,count)$0.0
    for_i. i.count do.
        for_j. (i+1)+i.count-(i+1)do.
            value =. x vector_distance (i{y),:j{y
            matrix =. value (<i,j)}matrix
            matrix =. value (<j,i)}matrix
        end.
    end.
    matrix
)

ScriptPath =: >{:4!:3''

Digits =: '0123456789'

number =: 3 : 0
    y =. x:y
    sign =. ''
    if. y<0 do. sign =. '-'
        y =. -y end.
    text =. ''
    while. y>0 do. text =. ((10|y){Digits),text
        y =. <.y%10x end.
    if. #text do. sign,text else. '0' end.
)
split =: 4 : 0
    parts =. 0$a:
    while. 1 do.
        position =. y i.x
        parts =. parts,<position{.y
        if. position=#y do. parts return. end.
        y =. (position+1)}.y
    end.
)
join =: 4 : 0
    text =. ''
    for_index. i.#y do.
        if. index do. text =. text,x end.
        value =. index{::y
        if. 2~:3!:0 value do. value =. number value end.
        text =. text,value
    end.
    text
)
format =: 4 : 0
    parts =. '|'split x
    text =. 0{::parts
    for_index. i.#y do.
        value =. index{::y
        if. 2~:3!:0 value do. value =. number value end.
        text =. text,value,(index+1){::parts
    end.

)
ascii_order =: 3 : '/: > (a.&i.)&.> y'
four_digit =: 3 : 0
    value =. x:y
    (*value)*<.(1r2)+10000*|value
)
real =: 3 : 0
    if. 2=3!:0 y do. '-' return. end.
    rounded =. four_digit y
    sign =. ''
    if. rounded<0 do. sign =. '-'
        rounded =. -rounded end.
    tail =. number 10000|rounded
    sign,(number <.rounded%10000x),'.',((4-#tail)$'0'),tail
)

integers =: 3 : ''' ''join <"0 y'

ari_text =: 3 : '(number 0{y),''/'',(number 1{y),'' '',real ari_value y'

paragraph =: 4 : 0

)

load SourceDirectory,'distances.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'agglomerative.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'dendrogram.ijs'

pair_values =: 3 : 0
    values =. 0$0.0
    for_i. i.#y do.
        for_j. (i+1)+i.(#y)-(i+1)do. values =. values,(<i,j){y end.
    end.
    values
)
histogram_bin =: 4 : '9<.<.(10*y)%x'
cluster_members =: 3 : 0
    members =. 0$a:
    for_group. 1+i.>./y do. members =. members,<I.y=group end.
    members
)
centroid =: 3 : 0
    center =. 0$0.0
    for_feature. i.{:$y do. center =. center,(sequential_sum feature{"1 y)%#y end.
    center
)
centroids =: 3 : 0
    centers =. (0,FeatureCount)$0.0
    for_members. cluster_members y do. centers =. centers,centroid (>members){Vectors end.
    centers
)
majority_class =: 3 : 'y i.>./y'
make_tree =: 4 : 0
    count =. y
    merges =. x
    heights =. subtree_heights =. 0$0.0
    children =. merges ordered_children count
    order =. count leaf_order children
    members =. <"0 i.count
    depths =. count$0
    for_merge. merges do.
        merge =. >merge
        a =. 0{::merge
        b =. 1{::merge
        height =. 2{::merge
        heights =. heights,height
        members =. members,<(a{::members),b{::members
        depths =. depths,1+(a{depths)>.b{depths
        first =. second =. 0.0
        if. a>:count do. first =. (a-count){subtree_heights end.
        if. b>:count do. second =. (b-count){subtree_heights end.
        subtree_heights =. subtree_heights,height>.first>.second
    end.
    (<count),(<merges),(<heights),(<children),(<order),(<members),(<depths),<subtree_heights
)
cut_partition =: 4 : 0
    count =. 0{::x
    owner =. i.count
    members =. 5{::x
    for_step. I.y do.
        node =. count+step
        owner =. node (node{::members)}owner
    end.
    numbers =. ((2*count)-1)$0
    groups =. 0
    for_leaf. 4{::x do.
        node =. leaf{owner
        if. 0=node{numbers do. groups =. groups+1
            numbers =. groups node}numbers end.
    end.
    owner{numbers
)
cut_into =: 4 : 'x cut_partition (i.(0{::x)-1)<(0{::x)-y'
cut_at =: 4 : 'x cut_partition (7{::x)<:y'
tree_cophenetic =: 3 : 0
    count =. 0{::y
    members =. 5{::y
    matrix =. (count,count)$0.0
    for_merge. 1{::y do.
        merge =. >merge
        a =. 0{::merge
        b =. 1{::merge
        height =. 2{::merge
        for_i. a{::members do.
            for_j. b{::members do.
                matrix =. height (<i,j)}matrix
                matrix =. height (<j,i)}matrix
            end.
        end.
    end.
    pair_values matrix
)
joining_heights =: 3 : 0
    count =. 0{::y
    heights =. count$0.0
    for_merge. 1{::y do.
        merge =. >merge
        for_child. >0 1{merge do.
            if. child<count do. heights =. (2{::merge)child}heights end.
        end.
    end.
    heights
)
height_sequence =: 4 : 0
    'step depth' =. y
    if. depth=0 do. 0$0.0 return. end.
    count =. 0{::x
    merge =. step{::1{::x
    values =. ,2{::merge
    for_child. >0 1{merge do.
        if. child>:count do. values =. values,x height_sequence (child-count),depth-1 end.
    end.
    values
)
tree_height =: 4 : 0
    if. y<0{::x do. 0.0 else. (y-0{::x){2{::x end.
)
tree_newick =: 4 : 0
    count =. 0{::x
    if. y<count do. y{::Ids return. end.
    'upper lower' =. (y-count){3{::x
    height =. x tree_height y
    '(', (x tree_newick upper),':',(real height-x tree_height upper),',',(x tree_newick lower),':',(real height-x tree_height lower),')'
)
class_table =: 3 : '((>./y),ClassCount)contingency_table (<y-1),<Targets'
label_ari =: 3 : 'adjusted_rand_index class_table y'
partition_ari =: 4 : 'adjusted_rand_index ((>./x),>./y)contingency_table (<x-1),<y-1'
match_count =: 3 : '+/>./"1 class_table y'
mean_silhouette =: 4 : 0
    if. (>./x)<2 do. ''
    else. (sequential_sum x silhouette_values y)%#x end.
)
within_sum =: 3 : 0
    centers =. centroids y
    total =. 0.0
    for_i. i.Count do. total =. total+(i{Vectors)squared_distance ((i{y)-1){centers end.
    total
)
evaluate =: 3 : 0
    groups =. >./y
    members =. cluster_members y
    sizes =. #&>members
    wss =. within_sum y
    silhouette =. y mean_silhouette Distances
    diameter =. separation =. 0.0
    found =. 0
    for_i. i.Count do.
        for_j. (i+1)+i.Count-(i+1)do.
            value =. (<i,j){Distances
            if. (i{y)=j{y do. diameter =. diameter>.value
            elseif. (-.found)+.value<separation do. separation =. value
                found =. 1 end.
        end.
    end.
    dunn =. ch =. ''
    if. (groups>:2)*.diameter>0 do. dunn =. separation%diameter end.
    if. (groups>:2)*.groups<Count do.
        overall =. centroid Vectors
        centers =. centroids y
        bss =. 0.0
        for_group. i.groups do. bss =. bss+(group{sizes)*(group{centers)squared_distance overall end.
        ch =. (bss%groups-1)%(wss%Count-groups)
    end.
    (<y),(<sizes),(<silhouette),(<dunn),(<wss),(<ch),<label_ari y
)
evaluation_text =: 3 : 0
    'partition sizes silhouette dunn wss ch ari' =. y
    'sizes | silhouette | dunn | wss | ch | ari |'format (integers sizes);(real silhouette);(real dunn);(real wss);(real ch);ari_text ari
)
analyse_linkage =: 3 : 0
    tree =. (y agglomerate Distances)make_tree Count
    cophenetic =. tree_cophenetic tree
    height_cuts =. count_cuts =. 0$a:
    for_height. CutHeights do. height_cuts =. height_cuts,<evaluate tree cut_at height end.
    for_count. CutCounts do. count_cuts =. count_cuts,<evaluate tree cut_into count end.
    (<y),(<tree),(<cophenetic),(<DistancePairs correlation cophenetic),(<height_cuts),(<count_cuts),<tree cut_into ClassCount
)
prepare_study =: 3 : 0
    read_dataset''
    'Means Deviations' =: feature_statistics Raw
    Vectors =: Raw
    if. Standardize-:'yes' do. Vectors =: (Means;Deviations)standardize_vectors Raw end.
    Distances =: DistanceName distance_matrix Vectors
    DistancePairs =: pair_values Distances
    DistanceMax =: >./DistancePairs
    Neighbors =: 0$0
    for_i. i.Count do.
        best =. _1
        for_j. i.Count do.
            if. i=j do. continue. end.
            if. best<0 do. best =. j
            elseif. ((<i,j){Distances)<(<i,best){Distances do. best =. j end.
        end.
        Neighbors =: Neighbors,best
    end.
    Results =: 0$a:
    for_method. Linkages do. Results =: Results,<analyse_linkage >method end.
    ChosenIndex =: ChosenPosition =: 0
    for_method. i.#Results do.
        cuts =. 5{::method{::Results
        for_position. i.#CutCounts do.
            best =. ChosenPosition{::5{::ChosenIndex{::Results
            if. (6{::position{::cuts)ari_greater 6{::best do.
                ChosenIndex =: method
                ChosenPosition =: position
            end.
        end.
    end.
    Chosen =: ChosenIndex{::Results
    Kappa =: ChosenPosition{CutCounts
    SelectedCut =: ChosenPosition{::5{::Chosen
    Selected =: 0{::SelectedCut
    Members =: cluster_members Selected
    Silhouettes =: Selected silhouette_values Distances
    ClassTable =: class_table Selected
    Majority =: majority_class"1 ClassTable
    i.0
)
linkage_table =: 3 : 0
    lines =. <'method,step,a,b,height,size'
    for_result. Results do.
        result =. >result
        method =. 0{::result
        merges =. 1{::1{::result
        for_step. i.#merges do.
            'a b height size' =. step{::merges
            lines =. lines,<'|,|,|,|,|,|'format method;(step+1);a;b;(real height);size
        end.
    end.
    lines
)
clusters_table =: 3 : 0
    header =. 'id';'label'
    for_method. Linkages do.
        method =. >method
        for_index. i.#CutHeights do. header =. header,<method,'_h',number index+1 end.
        for_k. CutCounts do. header =. header,<method,'_k',number k end.
    end.
    lines =. <','join header
    for_i. i.Count do.
        row =. (i{Ids),i{Labels
        for_result. Results do.
            result =. >result
            for_cut. (4{::result),5{::result do. row =. row,<i{0{::>cut end.
        end.
        lines =. lines,<','join row
    end.
    lines
)
dendrogram_report =: 3 : 0
    lines =. 0$a:
    for_result. Results do.
        result =. >result
        tree =. 1{::result
        maximum =. >./2{::tree
        columns =. 0$0
        for_height. CutHeights do. columns =. columns,(maximum,Width)height_column height end.
        part =. <'dendrogram | height_max | width |'format (0{::result);(real maximum);Width
        part =. part,dendrogram_rows (<tree),(<maximum),<columns
        for_index. i.#CutHeights do.
            column =. '-'
            if. (index{columns)<:Width do. column =. number index{columns end.
            part =. part,<'cut | column |'format (real index{CutHeights);column
        end.
        lines =. lines paragraph part
    end.
    lines
)
trees_report =: 3 : 0
    lines =. 0$a:
    for_result. Results do.
        result =. >result
        tree =. 1{::result
        lines =. lines,<(0{::result),' ',(tree tree_newick (2*Count)-2),';'
    end.
    lines
)
pair_text =: 3 : 0
    'i j' =. y
    (real (<i,j){Distances),' ',(i{::Ids),' ',j{::Ids
)
data_part =: 3 : 0
    lines =. <'data n | features | classes | distance | standardize |'format Count;FeatureCount;ClassCount;DistanceName;Standardize
    for_feature. i.FeatureCount do. lines =. lines,<'feature | mean | sd |'format (feature{::FeatureNames);(real feature{Means);real feature{Deviations end.
    smallest =. largest =. 0 1
    for_i. i.Count do.
        for_j. (i+1)+i.Count-(i+1)do.
            value =. (<i,j){Distances
            if. value<(<smallest){Distances do. smallest =. i,j end.
            if. value>(<largest){Distances do. largest =. i,j end.
        end.
    end.
    lines =. lines,<'distances pairs | min | max | mean |'format (#DistancePairs);(pair_text smallest);(pair_text largest);real (sequential_sum DistancePairs)%#DistancePairs
    total =. 0.0
